meta.title: The Treasure Cards
meta.textType: story: a game with if instructions

paragraphs: On Thursday, August thirteenth, the Explorers met in the school library at one o'clock. Teacher Kim stood in front of the bookshelf with cards in her hand. Lily, Mia, Leo, and May stood in a line. "Today we play a treasure game," said Teacher Kim. "I hid a secret treasure in the library." She held up a red card, a blue card, and a green card. "If your card is red, turn left at the corner," she said. "If it is blue, turn right." "If it is green, go straight on to the window." Then she gave one card to each child. Lily got a green card. Mia and Leo got red cards. May got a blue card. "Before you move, look at your card," said Teacher Kim.

"Go!" said Teacher Kim. Mia walked across the room to the corner and turned left. May turned right, because her card was blue. Lily walked straight on to the window. Leo had a red card too, but he turned right. "Leo, red is left!" said Mia. Leo looked at his card and laughed. "Oh no, I forgot," he said. "Which way is left?" he asked. Mia pointed the other way. Leo turned around and followed her.

Teacher Kim stood at the front with a small bell. "Now listen to the bell," she said. "If you hear the bell once, wait." "If you hear it twice, continue to the middle table." The bell rang once, and the four children waited. Nobody moved. Then the bell rang twice. Everyone continued to the middle table. A small wooden box was under a big book on the table. Lily found it first. May opened the box, and the children cheered. Inside, there were pencils with a paw print.

Afterwards, everyone sat at the table. "The paw print is the club sign," said Teacher Kim. Each child took a pencil. "Which part was the best?" asked Teacher Kim. "I liked the bell," said May. "If I look at my card first, I turn the right way," said Leo. Everyone laughed.
text.summary: Teacher Kim hides a treasure in the library and gives each child a color card. The children follow if instructions, and Leo turns the wrong way.
